title: Buttons: Disabled (Flowbite)
notes:
Use the following styles to indicate a disabled button. This can be often used inside form elements to disable the submit button before all the form elements have been completed and validated.

Original file: https://github.com/themesberg/flowbite/blob/main/content/components/buttons.md
code: <button type="button" class="text-fg-disabled bg-disabled box-border border border-default-medium shadow-xs font-medium leading-5 rounded-base text-sm px-4 py-2.5 focus:outline-none" disabled>Disabled button</button>
